Account summary:
- Mid-market SaaS company building a product intelligence layer on top of customer docs and support tickets. Primary feature: smart search + agent for customers and CS agents.
POC summary:
- Started on Hosted API (embeddings + reranking). Results positive: ~18% recall lift, average token cost within expectations.
- Requested Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation (VPC). Ran Dedicated demo -> observed stable p50 ~120ms with continuous batching.
Commercial asks (detailed):
- Want a 12-month reserved commit. Proposed commit structure: 8M tokens/month baseline for first 3 months, ramp to 20M tokens/month by month 7 (quarterly ramp).
- Burst: customer asks for a 20% burst pool above commit available monthly without immediate overage charge, with true-up at quarter end.
- Overage: customer requests blended overage rate (dedicated overage at 1.6x hosted list) and floor protection for month-1 ramp.
- Ramp schedule: Q1 conservative (8M -> 12M), Q2 accelerate to target. Wants ability to increase commit mid-contract with 30-day notice.
- Upfront vs monthly: evaluating 100% upfront discount vs 10% monthly billing; preference toward partial upfront to hit finance targets.
Security / compliance notes:
- Customer requires SSO/SAML + centralized audit logs (retain 12 months).
- KMS: must be able to bring-key for encryption-at-rest for all customer keys in Dedicated. Legal is asking for specific KMS language in SOW.
Technical / Ops constraints:
- Region: primary NA, but data residency requirement for EU subset of customers (may need regional routing later).
- SLA expectations: 99.9% uptime, max p95 latency target 350ms for chat; want automatic fallback to hosted/compatible model if Dedicated capacity constrained.

- AE (Jordan) delivered 3 pricing scenarios (conservative, balanced, aggressive). Customer favors balanced: 12-month, mid-tier commit, 20% burst, 1.6x overage.
- Sales asked Pricing for exact dollar amounts per commit tier + the math for true-up and effective blended unit price.
- Legal: needs indemnity/KMS clause clarity; procurement flagged SOC2 doc and longer retention SLA.
